changes: Maintainer-only resumable notarization helper using an existing Keychain profile label
Apple-anchored certificate requirement, expected team, hardened runtime, timestamp, executable permissions, universal architectures and wheel pin
Private copied app; input app and installed owner setup preserved
Submission boundary and archive-bound receipt prevent blind reuploads after interruption
Accepted Apple log must match exact job, archive and SHA-256
Ticket validation, unchanged code hashes and system distribution check required before final ZIP
Final ZIP is privately extracted; signatures, wheel, ticket and distribution checks repeat on the unpacked app
Cached state cannot masquerade as fresh release validation; no automatic GitHub publication

limits: Protocol tests are not live Apple acceptance
No private account authentication or physical-device acceptance
Publisher process remains a trusted local process; this is not broker OS isolation

privacy: Public record excludes credentials, profile labels, personal identifiers, private paths and raw diagnostic logs
